bullets.text: Residents in Thiruvallur staged a midnight protest over a severe power cut, and the office should monitor electricity restoration.

ITI students assaulted a government bus conductor in Avadi for questioning footboard travel, and authorities must ensure worker safety.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss accused high officials of plotting to destroy the Pallikaranai wetland, and the office should watch environmental protections.
A 44-year-old man was run over by a truck in Madhavaram after falling from his two-wheeler, and traffic safety should be reviewed.
Two cows and a deer died due to electrocution near Ponneri, and the district team should inspect local power lines.
A special education loan camp is being held at the Thiruvallur government hospital campus for local students.
Vultr launched a 20 MW AI supercompute cluster in Chennai with thousands of GPUs, boosting regional cloud infrastructure.
Vyoma.AI held a groundbreaking ceremony for a 52 MW AI-ready green data center in Chennai featuring liquid cooling.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss questioned whether actor-turned-politician Vijay can deliver good governance with DMK officials.
Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay inaugurated residential apartments and commercial complexes built by state agencies for Rs 1,021 crore.
